translations.idiomatic: The Palace Attendant announced the outer rites ready.

sentences.zh: 皇帝服通天冠、絳紗袍，乘輿出自西房，即御座西向。

translations.literal: The emperor in open-heaven crown and crimson gauze robe rode the carriage out from the west chamber and took the west-facing seat.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor in open-heaven crown and crimson gauze robe rode out from the west chamber to the west-facing seat.

sentences.zh: 羣官入就位。

translations.literal: Officials entered and took their places.
translations.idiomatic: Officials entered to their stations.

sentences.zh: 典儀曰：「再拜。

translations.literal: The Master of Ceremonies said: "Bow twice."
translations.idiomatic: The Master of Ceremonies called: "Bow twice."

sentences.zh: 」贊者承傳，在位者皆再拜。

translations.literal: " Announcers transmitted; all present bowed twice.
translations.idiomatic: " Announcers relayed; all present bowed twice.

sentences.zh: 皇太子入縣南，典儀曰：「再拜。

translations.literal: The crown prince entered south of the bells; the Master of Ceremonies said: "Bow twice."
translations.idiomatic: The crown prince entered south of the bells; the Master of Ceremonies called: "Bow twice."

sentences.zh: 」贊者承傳，皇太子再拜。

translations.literal: " Announcers transmitted; the crown prince bowed twice.
translations.idiomatic: " Announcers relayed; the crown prince bowed twice.

sentences.zh: 詣階，脫舄，升席西，南面立。

translations.literal: He came to the steps, removed shoes, ascended west of the mat, and stood south-facing.
translations.idiomatic: He came to the steps, removed his shoes, mounted west of the mat, and stood south-facing.

sentences.zh: 尚食酌酒於序，進詣皇太子西，東面立。

translations.literal: Imperial Food Service poured wine in the wing, advanced west of the crown prince, and stood east-facing.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial Food Service poured wine in the wing and advanced west of the crown prince, east-facing.

sentences.zh: 皇太子再拜，受爵。

translations.literal: The crown prince bowed twice and received the goblet.
translations.idiomatic: The crown prince bowed twice and took the goblet.

sentences.zh: 尚食又薦脯醢於席前。

translations.literal: Imperial Food Service again presented dried meat and hash before the mat.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial Food Service again presented dried meat and hash before the mat.

sentences.zh: 皇太子升席坐，左執爵，右取脯，擩於醢，祭於籩、豆之間。

translations.literal: The crown prince mounted the mat and sat, left hand on the goblet, right hand took dried meat, dipped in hash, and sacrificed between basket and dish.
translations.idiomatic: The crown prince sat on the mat, left on the goblet, right took dried meat, dipped hash, and offered between basket and dish.

sentences.zh: 右祭酒，興，降席西，南面坐，啐酒，奠爵，興，再拜，執爵興。

translations.literal: He sacrificed to the wine with the right hand, rose, descended west of the mat, sat south-facing, tasted the wine, set the goblet, rose, bowed twice, and took the goblet.
translations.idiomatic: He offered to the wine with his right hand, rose, sat south-facing west of the mat, tasted wine, set the goblet, rose, bowed twice, and took the goblet.

sentences.zh: 奉御受虛爵，直長徹薦，還於房。

translations.literal: Imperial Attendants received the empty goblet; chief stewards cleared the offering and returned to the chamber.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial attendants took the empty goblet; chief stewards cleared the offering and returned to the chamber.

sentences.zh: 皇太子進，當御座前，東面立。

translations.literal: The crown prince advanced and stood east-facing before the imperial seat.
translations.idiomatic: The crown prince advanced and stood east-facing before the throne.

sentences.zh: 皇帝命之曰：「往迎尒相，承我宗事，勗帥以敬。

translations.literal: The emperor charged him: "Go welcome your partner; uphold our ancestral affair; strive and lead with reverence."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor charged him: "Go welcome your consort; uphold our line; strive and lead with reverence."

sentences.zh: 」皇太子曰：「臣謹奉制旨。

translations.literal: The crown prince said: "Your servant respectfully receives the edict."
translations.idiomatic: The crown prince said: "I respectfully receive the edict."

sentences.zh: 」遂再拜，降自西階，納舄，出門。

translations.literal: He then bowed twice, descended the west steps, put on shoes, and went out the gate.
translations.idiomatic: He bowed twice, went down the west steps, put on shoes, and left the gate.

sentences.zh: 典儀曰：「再拜。

translations.literal: The Master of Ceremonies said: "Bow twice."
translations.idiomatic: The Master of Ceremonies called: "Bow twice."

sentences.zh: 」贊者承傳，在位者皆再拜，以次出。

translations.literal: " Announcers transmitted; all present bowed twice and departed in order.
translations.idiomatic: " Announcers relayed; all bowed twice and left in order.

sentences.zh: 侍中前跪奏「禮畢」。

translations.literal: The Palace Attendant advanced kneeling and reported: "The rite is complete."
translations.idiomatic: The Palace Attendant knelt forward and announced the rite complete.

sentences.zh: 皇帝入。

translations.literal: The emperor entered.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor withdrew.

sentences.zh: 皇太子既受命，執燭、前馬、鼓吹，至于妃氏大門外道西之次，回輅南向。

translations.literal: After receiving the charge, the crown prince took candles, outriders, and musicians to the lodge outside the consort's family great gate west of the road; the carriage turned south.
translations.idiomatic: After the charge, the crown prince with candles, outriders, and musicians reached the lodge west of the consort's main gate; the carriage turned south.

sentences.zh: 左庶子跪奏，降輅之次。

translations.literal: The Left Guardian knelt and reported, descending at the lodge.
translations.idiomatic: The Left Guardian knelt and reported; he descended at the lodge.

sentences.zh: 主人設几筵。

translations.literal: The host set armrest and mats.
translations.idiomatic: The host set armrest and mats.

sentences.zh: 妃服褕翟、花釵，立於東房，主婦立於房戶外之西，南向。

translations.literal: The consort in feather robe and flower hairpins stood in the east chamber; the hostess stood west outside the chamber door, south-facing.
translations.idiomatic: The consort in feather robe and flower pins stood in the east chamber; the hostess stood west outside the door, south-facing.

sentences.zh: 主人公服出，立於大門之內，西向。

translations.literal: The host in dark dress came out and stood inside the great gate, west-facing.
translations.idiomatic: The host in dark dress stood inside the main gate, west-facing.

sentences.zh: 在廟則祭服。

translations.literal: In the temple he wore sacrificial dress.
translations.idiomatic: At the ancestral temple he wore sacrificial dress.

sentences.zh: 左庶子跪奏「請就位」。

translations.literal: The Left Guardian knelt and reported: "Please take your place."
translations.idiomatic: The Left Guardian knelt and reported: "Please take your station."

sentences.zh: 皇太子立於門西，東面。

translations.literal: The crown prince stood west of the gate, east-facing.
translations.idiomatic: The crown prince stood west of the gate, east-facing.

sentences.zh: 儐者受命出請事，左庶子承傳跪奏，皇太子曰：「以茲初昏，某奉制承命。

translations.literal: The usher received the command and came out to ask business; the Left Guardian transmitted kneeling and reporting; the crown prince said: "At this first dusk, So-and-so, by edict, bears commission."
translations.idiomatic: The usher asked business; the Left Guardian relayed kneeling; the crown prince said: "At this first dusk, So-and-so, by edict, bears commission."

sentences.zh: 」左庶子俛伏，興，傳於儐者，入告，主人曰：「某謹敬具以須。

translations.literal: The Left Guardian bowed prostrate, rose, and transmitted to the usher, who entered and reported; the host said: "So-and-so respectfully stands ready."
translations.idiomatic: The Left Guardian prostrated, rose, and passed it to the usher, who announced; the host said: "So-and-so stands ready."

sentences.zh: 」儐者出，傳於左庶子以奏。

translations.literal: The usher came out, transmitted to the Left Guardian to report.
translations.idiomatic: The usher came out and relayed to the Left Guardian to report.

sentences.zh: 儐者入，引主人迎於門外之東，西面再拜，皇太子答再拜。

translations.literal: The usher entered, led the host to meet east outside the gate; west-facing bowed twice; the crown prince returned bow twice.
translations.idiomatic: The usher led the host to meet east outside the gate; he bowed twice west-facing; the crown prince returned bow twice.

sentences.zh: 主人揖皇太子先入，掌畜者以鴈授左庶子，以授皇太子，執鴈入。

translations.literal: The host gestured for the crown prince to enter first; the livestock officer handed geese to the Left Guardian, who gave them to the crown prince, who carried them in.
translations.idiomatic: The host motioned the crown prince in first; the livestock officer gave geese to the Left Guardian, who passed them to the crown prince to carry in.

sentences.zh: 及內門，主人讓曰：「請皇太子入。

translations.literal: At the inner gate the host yielded: "Please, Crown Prince, enter."
translations.idiomatic: At the inner gate the host yielded: "Please enter, Crown Prince."

sentences.zh: 」皇太子曰：「某弗敢先。

translations.literal: The crown prince said: "I dare not go first."
translations.idiomatic: The crown prince said: "I dare not go first."

sentences.zh: 」主人又固請，皇太子又曰：「某固弗敢先。

translations.literal: The host again firmly requested; the crown prince again said: "I firmly dare not go first."
translations.idiomatic: The host insisted; the crown prince again said he firmly dared not go first.

sentences.zh: 」主人揖，皇太子入門而左，主人入門而右。

translations.literal: The host gestured; the crown prince entered the gate to the left, the host to the right.
translations.idiomatic: The host gestured; the crown prince entered left, the host right.

sentences.zh: 及內門，主人揖入，及內霤，當曲揖，當階揖，皇太子皆報揖。

translations.literal: At the inner gate the host gestured in; at the inner eaves, at each bend, at the steps, the crown prince returned each gesture.
translations.idiomatic: At the inner gate the host gestured him in; at inner eaves, bends, and steps the crown prince returned each bow.

sentences.zh: 至於階，主人曰：「請皇太子升。

translations.literal: At the steps the host said: "Please, Crown Prince, ascend."
translations.idiomatic: At the steps the host said: "Please mount, Crown Prince."

sentences.zh: 」皇太子曰：「某敢辭。

translations.literal: The crown prince said: "I venture to decline."
translations.idiomatic: The crown prince declined.

sentences.zh: 」主人固請，皇太子又曰：「某敢固辭。

translations.literal: The host firmly requested; the crown prince again said: "I firmly venture to decline."
translations.idiomatic: The host insisted; the crown prince firmly declined again.

sentences.zh: 」主人終請，皇太子又曰：「某終辭。

translations.literal: The host finally requested; the crown prince finally said: "I finally decline."
translations.idiomatic: The host asked finally; the crown prince finally declined.

sentences.zh: 」主人揖，皇太子報揖。

translations.literal: The host gestured; the crown prince returned the gesture.
translations.idiomatic: The host gestured; the crown prince returned it.

sentences.zh: 主人升，立於阼階上，西面。

translations.literal: The host ascended and stood on the host steps, west-facing.
translations.idiomatic: The host mounted the host steps, west-facing.

sentences.zh: 皇太子升，進當房戶前，北面，跪奠鴈，再拜，降，出。

translations.literal: The crown prince ascended, advanced before the chamber door, north-facing, knelt and set the geese, bowed twice, descended, and went out.
translations.idiomatic: The crown prince mounted, advanced before the chamber door, knelt north-facing, set the geese, bowed twice, descended, and left.

sentences.zh: 主人不降送。

translations.literal: The host did not descend to see him off.
translations.idiomatic: The host did not come down to see him off.

sentences.zh: 內廄尉進厭翟於內門外，傅姆導妃，司則前引，出於母左。

translations.literal: Inner Stables Captain advanced the disdain carriage outside the inner gate; the instructress guided the consort; the Chief Steward led before; she came out from her mother's left.
translations.idiomatic: Inner Stables Captain brought the disdain carriage outside the inner gate; the instructress guided the consort; Chief Steward led; she came out from her mother's left.

sentences.zh: 師姆在右，保姆在左。

translations.literal: The teacher-mother right; the nurse-mother left.
translations.idiomatic: Teacher-mother on the right; nurse-mother on the left.

sentences.zh: 父少進，西面戒之曰：「必有正焉，若衣花。

translations.literal: The father advanced slightly, west-facing, and warned her: "You must have rectitude, like flowers on cloth."
translations.idiomatic: The father stepped forward west-facing and warned: "Keep rectitude, like blossoms on cloth."

sentences.zh: 」命之曰：「戒之敬之，夙夜無違命。

translations.literal: He charged her: "Be vigilant and reverent; morning and night do not disobey the command."
translations.idiomatic: He charged her: "Be vigilant and reverent; never disobey the command day or night."

sentences.zh: 」母戒之西階上，施衿結帨，命之曰：「勉之敬之，夙夜無違命。

translations.literal: The mother warned from the west steps, attached collar and tied sash, charging: "Strive and be reverent; morning and night do not disobey the command."
translations.idiomatic: The mother warned from the west steps, fixed collar and sash: "Strive and be reverent; never disobey the command day or night."

sentences.zh: 」庶母及門內施鞶，申之以父母之命，命之曰：「敬恭聽宗父母之言，夙夜無愆。

translations.literal: The secondary mother at the inner gate attached the sash-pouch and conveyed the parents' charge: "Respectfully heed your clan parents' words; morning and night be without fault."
translations.idiomatic: The secondary mother at the inner gate fixed the sash-pouch and relayed the parents: "Heed your clan parents; be without fault day and night."

sentences.zh: 視諸衿鞶。

translations.literal: " Look to all collars and sashes.
translations.idiomatic: " Mind every collar and sash."

sentences.zh: 」妃既出內門，至輅後，皇太子授綏，姆辭不受，曰：「未教，不足與為禮。

translations.literal: " After the consort left the inner gate, at the carriage rear the crown prince handed the mounting cord; the instructress declined, saying: "Not yet instructed—unfit to share the rite."
translations.idiomatic: " At the carriage rear the crown prince offered the mounting cord; the instructress declined: "Not yet instructed—unfit for this rite."

sentences.zh: 」妃升輅，乘以几，姆加景。

translations.literal: The consort mounted the carriage with armrest; the instructress added the sunshade.
translations.idiomatic: The consort mounted with armrest; the instructress added the sunshade.

sentences.zh: 皇太子馭輪三周，馭者代之。

translations.literal: The crown prince drove the wheels three circuits; the driver replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: The crown prince drove three circuits around the wheels; the driver then took over.

sentences.zh: 皇太子出大門，乘輅還宮，妃次於後。

translations.literal: The crown prince left the great gate, mounted the carriage, and returned to the palace; the consort followed behind.
translations.idiomatic: The crown prince left the main gate, mounted, and returned to the palace; the consort followed.

sentences.zh: 主人使其屬送妃，以族從。

translations.literal: The host sent his followers to escort the consort with clan kin.
translations.idiomatic: The host sent followers to escort the consort with clan kin.

sentences.zh: 同牢之日，司閨設妃次於閤內道東，南向。

translations.literal: On the shared-meal day the Court Chamberlain set the consort's lodge east of the lane inside the private gate, south-facing.
translations.idiomatic: On the shared-meal day the Court Chamberlain set the consort's lodge east inside the private gate lane, south-facing.

sentences.zh: 設皇太子御幄於內殿室內西廂，東向。

translations.literal: The crown prince's curtain-bed was set in the west wing of the inner hall chamber, east-facing.
translations.idiomatic: The crown prince's bed-curtain was set in the inner hall's west wing, east-facing.

sentences.zh: 設席重茵，施屏障。

translations.literal: Layered mats and screens were set.
translations.idiomatic: Layered mats and screens were set.

sentences.zh: 設同牢之席於室內，皇太子之席西廂，東向，妃席東廂，西向。

translations.literal: The shared-meal mats were set inside the chamber: crown prince's mat in the west wing east-facing; consort's mat in the east wing west-facing.
translations.idiomatic: Shared-meal mats inside the chamber: crown prince west wing east-facing; consort east wing west-facing.

sentences.zh: 席閒量容牢饌。

translations.literal: Between the mats space was left for the full pen feast.
translations.idiomatic: Space between the mats fit the full pen feast.

sentences.zh: 設洗於東階東南，設妃洗於東房近北。

translations.literal: A lavabo was set southeast of the east steps; the consort's lavabo near the north of the east chamber.
translations.idiomatic: A lavabo southeast of the east steps; the consort's lavabo near the north of the east chamber.

sentences.zh: 饌於東房西墉下，籩、豆各二十，簠、簋各二，鈃各三，瓦豋一，俎三。

translations.literal: Food under the west wall of the east chamber: twenty baskets and dishes each, two grain trays and bowls, three basins, one earthen tureen, three meat trays.
translations.idiomatic: Food under the east chamber's west wall: twenty baskets and dishes, two grain trays and bowls, three basins, one earthen tureen, three meat trays.

sentences.zh: 尊在室內北墉下，玄酒在西。

translations.literal: Wine jar at the north wall inside the chamber; black wine west.
translations.idiomatic: Wine jar at the north wall inside the chamber, black wine west.

sentences.zh: 又設尊於房戶外之東，無玄酒。

translations.literal: Another jar east outside the chamber door; no black wine.
translations.idiomatic: Another jar east outside the chamber door, without black wine.

sentences.zh: 篚在南，實四爵，合巹。

translations.literal: Basket south; four goblets filled; nuptial gourds joined.
translations.idiomatic: Basket to the south; four goblets filled; nuptial gourds joined.

sentences.zh: 皇太子車至左閤，回輅南向，左庶子跪奏「請降輅」。

translations.literal: When the crown prince's carriage reached the left private gate, the carriage turned south; the Left Guardian knelt and reported: "Please descend at the carriage."
translations.idiomatic: At the left private gate the carriage turned south; the Left Guardian knelt and asked him to descend.

sentences.zh: 入俟於內殿門外之東，西面。

translations.literal: He entered and waited east outside the inner hall gate, west-facing.
translations.idiomatic: He entered and waited east outside the inner hall gate, west-facing.

sentences.zh: 妃至左閤外，回輅南向，司則請妃降輅，前後扇、燭。

translations.literal: When the consort reached outside the left private gate, the carriage turned south; the Chief Steward asked her to descend; fans and candles before and behind.
translations.idiomatic: At the left private gate the consort's carriage turned south; the Chief Steward asked her to descend with fans and candles fore and aft.

sentences.zh: 就次立於內殿門西，東面。

translations.literal: She took her place west of the inner hall gate, east-facing.
translations.idiomatic: She took station west of the inner hall gate, east-facing.

sentences.zh: 皇太子揖以入，升自西階，妃從升。

translations.literal: The crown prince gestured her in; both ascended the west steps; the consort followed up.
translations.idiomatic: The crown prince motioned her in; both mounted the west steps, the consort following.

sentences.zh: 執扇、燭者陳於東、西階內。

translations.literal: Fan and candle bearers were arrayed inside the east and west steps.
translations.idiomatic: Fan and candle bearers lined the inner east and west steps.

sentences.zh: 皇太子即席，東向立，妃西向立。

translations.literal: The crown prince took the mat and stood east-facing; the consort stood west-facing.
translations.idiomatic: The crown prince took the mat east-facing; the consort west-facing.

sentences.zh: 司饌進詣階間，跪奏「具牢饌」，司則承令曰：「諾。

translations.literal: Chief Food Officer advanced to the steps, knelt, and reported: "The pen feast is ready"; the Chief Steward transmitted: "Yes."
translations.idiomatic: Chief Food Officer advanced to the steps, knelt, and announced the pen feast ready; the Chief Steward relayed assent.

sentences.zh: 」遂設饌如皇后同牢之禮。

translations.literal: " Food was then set as at the empress shared meal.
translations.idiomatic: " Food was set as at the empress shared meal.

sentences.zh: 司饌跪奏「饌具」。

translations.literal: Chief Food Officer knelt and reported: "The food is ready."
translations.idiomatic: Chief Food Officer knelt and announced the food ready.

sentences.zh: 皇太子及妃俱坐。

translations.literal: Crown prince and consort both sat.
translations.idiomatic: Crown prince and consort sat.

sentences.zh: 司饌跪取脯、取韭葅，皆擩於醢，授皇太子，又取授妃，俱受，祭於籩、豆之間。

translations.literal: Chief Food Officer knelt, took dried meat and leek hash, dipped in sauce, handed to the crown prince; again took and handed to the consort; both received and sacrificed between basket and dish.
translations.idiomatic: Chief Food Officer knelt, took dried meat and leek hash dipped in sauce for the crown prince, then for the consort; both offered between basket and dish.

sentences.zh: 司饌跪取黍實於左手，遍取稷反於右手，授皇太子，又授妃，各受，祭於葅醢之間。

translations.literal: Chief Food Officer knelt, took millet in the left hand, gathered glutinous in the right, handed to the crown prince; again handed to the consort; each received and sacrificed between hash dishes.
translations.idiomatic: Chief Food Officer knelt, millet in the left hand and glutinous in the right for the crown prince, then the consort; each offered between the hash dishes.

sentences.zh: 司饌各立，取胏皆絕末，跪授皇太子及妃，俱受，又祭於葅醢之間。

translations.literal: Chief Food Officer each stood, took rib ends, knelt, handed to crown prince and consort; both received and again sacrificed between hash dishes.
translations.idiomatic: Chief Food Officer stood, took rib ends, knelt, and gave them to crown prince and consort; both offered again between the hash dishes.

sentences.zh: 司饌俱以胏加於俎。

translations.literal: Chief Food Officer both placed the ribs on the trays.
translations.idiomatic: Chief Food Officer set the ribs on the trays.

sentences.zh: 掌嚴授皇太子妃巾，涗手。

translations.literal: Palace Strictness handed towels to crown prince and consort; they wiped hands.
translations.idiomatic: Palace Strictness gave towels; crown prince and consort wiped their hands.

sentences.zh: 以柶扱上鈃遍擩之，祭於上豆之間。

translations.literal: With ladles they dipped the upper basin all through, sacrificed between the upper dishes.
translations.idiomatic: With ladles they dipped the upper basin throughout and offered between the upper dishes.

sentences.zh: 司饌品嘗妃饌，移黍置於席上，以次跪授胏脊。

translations.literal: Chief Food Officer tasted the consort's food, moved millet to the mat, then in order knelt and handed rib and spine.
translations.idiomatic: Chief Food Officer tasted the consort's food, moved millet to the mat, then knelt and handed rib and spine in order.

sentences.zh: 皇太子及妃皆食以湆醬，三飯，卒食。

translations.literal: Crown prince and consort all ate with broth and sauce, three mouthfuls, finished eating.
translations.idiomatic: Crown prince and consort ate with broth and sauce, three mouthfuls, and finished.

sentences.zh: 司饌北面請進酒，司則承令曰：「諾。

translations.literal: Chief Food Officer north-facing requested wine advance; the Chief Steward transmitted: "Yes."
translations.idiomatic: Chief Food Officer north-facing asked to advance wine; the Chief Steward assented.

sentences.zh: 」司饌二人俱盥手洗爵於房，入室，酌于尊，北面立。

translations.literal: Two Chief Food Officers both washed hands and rinsed goblets in the chamber, entered, poured from the jar, and stood north-facing.
translations.idiomatic: Two food officers washed hands and goblets in the chamber, entered, poured from the jar, and stood north-facing.

sentences.zh: 皇太子及妃俱興，再拜。

translations.literal: Crown prince and consort both rose and bowed twice.
translations.idiomatic: Crown prince and consort rose and bowed twice.

sentences.zh: 一人進授皇太子，一人授妃，皇太子及妃俱坐，祭酒，舉酒，司饌各以肝從，司則進受虛爵，奠於篚。

translations.literal: One advanced and handed to the crown prince; one to the consort; crown prince and consort sat, sacrificed to wine, raised wine; Chief Food Officer each followed with liver; Chief Steward advanced, received empty goblets, and set them in the basket.
translations.idiomatic: One handed to the crown prince, one to the consort; both sat, offered to wine, and drank; food officers followed with liver; Chief Steward took empty goblets to the basket.

sentences.zh: 司饌又俱洗爵，酌酒，再酳，皇太子及妃俱受爵飲。

translations.literal: Chief Food Officer again both washed goblets, poured wine; second toast; crown prince and consort both received goblets and drank.
translations.idiomatic: Food officers again washed goblets and poured; at the second toast crown prince and consort drank.

sentences.zh: 三酳用巹，如再酳。

translations.literal: Third toast used nuptial gourds, as at the second toast.
translations.idiomatic: Third toast used nuptial gourds, as the second.

sentences.zh: 皇太子及妃立於席後，司則俱降東階，洗爵，升，酌於戶外，北面，俱奠爵，興，再拜。

translations.literal: Crown prince and consort stood behind the mats; Chief Steward both descended the east steps, washed goblets, ascended, poured outside the door, north-facing, both set goblets, rose, bowed twice.
translations.idiomatic: Crown prince and consort stood behind the mats; Chief Steward went down the east steps, washed goblets, mounted, poured outside, north-facing set both goblets, rose, and bowed twice.

sentences.zh: 皇太子及妃俱答拜。

translations.literal: Crown prince and consort both returned the bow.
translations.idiomatic: Crown prince and consort returned the bow.

sentences.zh: 司則坐，取爵祭酒，遂飲，啐爵，奠，遂拜，執爵興，降，奠爵於篚。

translations.literal: Chief Steward sat, took the goblet, sacrificed to the wine, then drank, tasted the goblet, set it down, bowed, took the goblet, rose, descended, and set it in the basket.
translations.idiomatic: Chief Steward sat, took a goblet, offered to the wine, drank, tasted, set it down, bowed, rose, descended, and placed it in the basket.

sentences.zh: 司饌奏「徹饌」。

translations.literal: Chief Food Officer reported: "Clear the food."
translations.idiomatic: Chief Food Officer announced clearing the food.

sentences.zh: 司則前跪奏稱：「司則妾姓言，請殿下入。

translations.literal: Chief Steward advanced kneeling and reported: "Chief Steward your servant So-and-so reports—please, Your Highness, enter."
translations.idiomatic: Chief Steward knelt forward: "Your servant So-and-so asks the crown prince to enter."

sentences.zh: 」皇太子入於東房，釋冕服，著袴褶。

translations.literal: The crown prince entered the east chamber, removed dragon robes, and wore trousers and jacket.
translations.idiomatic: The crown prince entered the east chamber, removed court robes, and wore trousers and jacket.

sentences.zh: 司則啟妃入幃幄，皇太子乃入室。

translations.literal: Chief Steward opened the curtain for the consort to enter; the crown prince then entered the chamber.
translations.idiomatic: Chief Steward opened the curtain for the consort; the crown prince then entered the chamber.

sentences.zh: 媵餕皇太子之饌，御餕妃之饌。

translations.literal: Concubines ate the crown prince's food; attendants ate the consort's food.
translations.idiomatic: Concubines ate the crown prince's leftovers; attendants ate the consort's.

sentences.zh: 親王納妃。

translations.literal: An imperial prince takes a consort.
translations.idiomatic: An imperial prince takes a consort.

sentences.zh: 其納采、問名、納吉、納徵、請期，使者公服，乘犢車，至於妃氏之家，主人受於廟若寢，其賓主相見，儐贊出入升降，與其禮賓者，大抵皆如皇太子之使，而無副。

translations.literal: For betrothal, name inquiry, auspicious acceptance, bride-price, and date request, the envoy in dark dress rode a calf cart to the consort's family; the host received at temple or apartment; guest and host meeting, ushering, entering, ascending, and descending, and entertaining the ritual guest were largely as for the crown prince's envoy but without a deputy.
translations.idiomatic: For betrothal, name inquiry, auspicious acceptance, bride-price, and date request, the envoy in dark dress rode a calf cart to the consort's house; the host received at temple or quarters; guest-host rites largely followed the crown prince's envoy but without a deputy.

sentences.zh: 其聘以玄纁束、乘馬，玉以璋。

translations.literal: The betrothal used black-red bundles and carriage horses; jade used the tablet form.
translations.idiomatic: Betrothal gifts were black-red bundles and horses; jade was in tablet form.

sentences.zh: 冊命之日，使者持節，有副。

translations.literal: On investiture day the envoy bore staff and had a deputy.
translations.idiomatic: On investiture day the envoy bore staff and had a deputy.

sentences.zh: 親迎。

translations.literal: Personal welcome.
translations.idiomatic: Personal welcome.

sentences.zh: 王衮冕輅車，至于妃氏之門外，主人布席於室戶外之西，西上，右几。

translations.literal: The prince in dragon robes and carriage reached outside the consort's gate; the host spread mats west outside the chamber door, west at the top, armrest right.
translations.idiomatic: The prince in dragon robes reached the consort's gate; the host spread mats west outside the chamber door, west at top, armrest to the right.

sentences.zh: 又席於戶內，南向。

translations.literal: Another mat inside the door, south-facing.
translations.idiomatic: Another mat inside the door, south-facing.

sentences.zh: 設甒醴於東房東北隅，篚在尊南，實觶一、角柶一，脯醢又在其南。

translations.literal: Black-cloth wine in the northeast corner of the east chamber; basket south of the jar; one goblet and one horn ladle filled; dried meat and hash farther south.
translations.idiomatic: Black-cloth wine in the east chamber's northeast corner; basket south of the jar; one goblet and horn ladle; dried meat and hash farther south.

sentences.zh: 妃於房內即席，南向立，姆立於右。

translations.literal: The consort at her mat inside the chamber stood south-facing; the instructress stood to her right.
translations.idiomatic: The consort stood south-facing at her mat inside the chamber; the instructress stood to her right.

sentences.zh: 主人立於戶之東，西面。

translations.literal: The host stood east of the door, west-facing.
translations.idiomatic: The host stood east of the door, west-facing.

sentences.zh: 內贊者以觶酌醴，加柶，覆之，面柄，進筵前，北面。

translations.literal: The inner announcer poured wine with ladle, covered handle-out, advanced before the mat, north-facing.
translations.idiomatic: The inner announcer poured wine, covered it handle-out, advanced before the mat, north-facing.

sentences.zh: 妃降席西，南面再拜，受觶。

translations.literal: The consort descended west of the mat, south-facing bowed twice, and received the goblet.
translations.idiomatic: The consort stepped down west of the mat, bowed twice south-facing, and received the goblet.

sentences.zh: 內贊者薦脯醢，妃升席，跪，左執觶，右取脯，擩於醢，祭於籩、豆之間，遂以柶祭醴三，始扱一祭，又扱再祭，興，筵末跪，啐醴，建柶，奠觶，降筵西，南面再拜，就席立。

translations.literal: The inner announcer presented dried meat and hash; the consort mounted the mat, knelt, left on the goblet, right took dried meat, dipped hash, sacrificed between basket and dish, then with the ladle sacrificed to the wine three times—first dip once, dip again twice—rose, knelt at the mat end, tasted wine, set the ladle upright, set the goblet, descended west of the mat, south-facing bowed twice, and stood at the mat.
translations.idiomatic: The inner announcer presented dried meat and hash; the consort mounted the mat, knelt, offered between basket and dish, ladle-offered to the wine three times, tasted wine at the mat end, set the goblet, descended, bowed twice south-facing, and stood.

sentences.zh: 主人乃迎賓。

translations.literal: The host then welcomed the guest.
translations.idiomatic: The host then welcomed the guest.

sentences.zh: 其餘皆如皇太子之迎。

translations.literal: The rest was all as at the crown prince's welcome.
translations.idiomatic: Everything else followed the crown prince's welcome.

sentences.zh: 初昏，設洗於東階東南，又設妃洗於東房近北。

translations.literal: At first dusk a lavabo was set southeast of the east steps; the consort's lavabo near the north of the east chamber.
translations.idiomatic: At first dusk a lavabo was set southeast of the east steps; the consort's lavabo near the north of the east chamber.

sentences.zh: 饌於東房，障以帷。

translations.literal: Food in the east chamber, screened by curtains.
translations.idiomatic: Food in the east chamber behind curtains.

sentences.zh: 豆十六，簠、簋各二，豋各二，俎三，羊豕、腊，羊豕節折，尊坫於室內北墉下，玄酒在西。

translations.literal: Sixteen dishes, two grain trays and bowls each, two tureens, three meat trays—sheep, pig, and cured meat; sheep and pig sectioned; wine stand at the north wall inside the chamber, black wine west.
translations.idiomatic: Sixteen dishes, two grain trays and bowls, two tureens, three trays of sheep, pig, and cured meat, sectioned sheep and pig; wine at the north wall inside, black wine west.

sentences.zh: 又設尊於房戶外之東，無玄酒，坫在南，實以四爵，合巹。

translations.literal: Another jar east outside the chamber door, no black wine; stand south; four goblets filled; nuptial gourds joined.
translations.idiomatic: Another jar east outside the door without black wine; stand south; four goblets; nuptial gourds joined.

sentences.zh: 王至，降車以俟；

translations.literal: When the prince arrived he descended the carriage to wait;
translations.idiomatic: When the prince arrived he descended to wait;

sentences.zh: 妃至，降車北面立。

translations.literal: when the consort arrived she descended and stood north-facing.
translations.idiomatic: when the consort arrived she descended and stood north-facing.

sentences.zh: 王南面揖妃以入，及寢門，又揖以入。

translations.literal: The prince south-facing gestured the consort in; at the sleeping gate he again gestured her in.
translations.idiomatic: The prince south-facing bowed her in; at the sleeping gate he bowed her in again.

sentences.zh: 贊者酌玄酒三注於尊，妃從者設席於奧，東向。

translations.literal: The announcer poured black wine three times into the jar; the consort's followers set the mat in the recess, east-facing.
translations.idiomatic: The announcer poured black wine three times; the consort's followers set the mat in the recess, east-facing.

sentences.zh: 王導妃升自西階，入於室，即席東面立。

translations.literal: The prince guided the consort up the west steps; entering the chamber she took the mat and stood east-facing.
translations.idiomatic: The prince guided her up the west steps; entering, she took the mat and stood east-facing.

sentences.zh: 妃入立於尊西，南面。

translations.literal: The consort entered and stood west of the jar, south-facing.
translations.idiomatic: The consort entered and stood west of the jar, south-facing.

sentences.zh: 王盥於南洗，妃從者沃之；

translations.literal: The prince washed at the south lavabo; the consort's followers poured for her;
translations.idiomatic: The prince washed at the south lavabo; her followers poured for the consort;

sentences.zh: 妃盥於北洗，王從者沃之。

translations.literal: the consort washed at the north lavabo; the prince's followers poured for him.
translations.idiomatic: she washed at the north lavabo; his followers poured for the prince.

sentences.zh: 俱復位，立。

translations.literal: Both returned to their places and stood.
translations.idiomatic: Both returned to station and stood.

sentences.zh: 贊者設饌入，西面，告「饌具。

translations.literal: The announcer set food in, west-facing, and announced: "The food is ready."
translations.idiomatic: The announcer brought food in west-facing and announced it ready.

sentences.zh: 」王揖妃，即對席，西面，皆坐。

translations.literal: The prince gestured the consort; they took facing mats, west-facing, and sat.
translations.idiomatic: The prince motioned the consort; on facing mats they sat west-facing.

sentences.zh: 其先祭而後飯，乃酳祭，至于燭入，皆如太子納妃之禮。

translations.literal: They first sacrificed then ate; then toast-sacrifices until candles were brought in—all as at crown prince taking a consort.
translations.idiomatic: They offered first, then ate, then toast-offerings until candles entered—all as when the crown prince took a consort.

sentences.zh: 公主出降。

translations.literal: A princess marries out.
translations.idiomatic: A princess marries out.

sentences.zh: 禮皆如王妃，而納采、問名、納吉、納徵、請期，主人皆受於寢。

translations.literal: The rites were all as for an imperial prince's consort, but for betrothal, name inquiry, auspicious acceptance, bride-price, and date request the host always received at the apartment.
translations.idiomatic: Rites followed an imperial prince's consort, but betrothal through date request were always received in the apartment.

sentences.zh: 其賓之辭曰：「國恩貺室於某公之子，某公有先人之禮，使某也請。

translations.literal: The guest's words: "The state's grace bestows a chamber on the son of Lord So-and-so; Lord So-and-so has his ancestors' rite—So-and-so requests it."
translations.idiomatic: The guest said: "By state grace a match is granted to Lord So-and-so's son; his family has ancestral rites—So-and-so requests them."

sentences.zh: 」主人命賓曰：「寡人有先皇之禮」云。

translations.literal: The host charged the guest: "This humble one has the former emperor's rite," and so on.
translations.idiomatic: The host told the guest: "I have the former emperor's rite," and so forth.

sentences.zh: 其諸臣之子，一品至于三品為一等，玄纁束、乘馬，玉以璋。

translations.literal: For sons of various ministers, first through third rank formed one grade: black-red bundles, carriage horses, jade tablet.
translations.idiomatic: Ministers' sons of ranks one through three formed one grade: black-red bundles, horses, jade tablet.

sentences.zh: 四品至于五品為一等，玄纁束、兩馬，無璋。

translations.literal: Fourth through fifth rank another grade: black-red bundles, two horses, no tablet.
translations.idiomatic: Ranks four through five another grade: black-red bundles, two horses, no tablet.

sentences.zh: 六品至于九品為一等，玄纁束、儷皮二，而無馬。

translations.literal: Sixth through ninth another grade: black-red bundles, paired pelts two, no horses.
translations.idiomatic: Ranks six through nine another grade: black-red bundles and two paired pelts, no horses.

sentences.zh: 儷皮二，內攝之，毛在內，左首，立於幕南。

translations.literal: Two paired pelts, fur inward, heads left, standing south of the canopy.
translations.idiomatic: Two paired pelts, fur inward, heads left, stood south of the canopy.

sentences.zh: 其餘納采、問名、納吉、納徵、請期，大抵皆如親王納妃。

translations.literal: The rest of betrothal, name inquiry, auspicious acceptance, bride-price, and date request were largely as for an imperial prince taking a consort.
translations.idiomatic: Betrothal through date request largely followed an imperial prince's consort rites.

sentences.zh: 其親迎之日，大昕，壻之父、女之父告於禰廟若寢。

translations.literal: On the welcome day, at dawn, the groom's father and the bride's father reported at the ancestor temple or apartment.
translations.idiomatic: On the welcome day at dawn both fathers reported at the ancestor temple or apartment.

sentences.zh: 將行，布席於東序，西向；

translations.literal: About to depart, mats were spread on the east wing, west-facing;
translations.idiomatic: Before departure, mats were spread on the east wing, west-facing;

sentences.zh: 又席於戶牖之間，南向。

translations.literal: another mat between the door panels, south-facing.
translations.idiomatic: another mat between the door panels, south-facing.

sentences.zh: 父公服，坐於東序，西向。

translations.literal: The father in dark dress sat on the east wing, west-facing.
translations.idiomatic: The father in dark dress sat on the east wing, west-facing.

sentences.zh: 子服其上服：一品衮冕，二品鷩冕，三品毳冕，四品絺冕，五品玄冕，六品爵弁。

translations.literal: The son wore his highest dress: first rank dragon robes, second startled, third fine-fur, fourth fine-silk, fifth black, sixth cap and coronet.
translations.idiomatic: The son wore his highest dress by rank: first dragon, second startled, third fine-fur, fourth fine-silk, fifth black, sixth cap and coronet.

sentences.zh: 庶人絳公服。

translations.literal: Commoners wore crimson dark dress.
translations.idiomatic: Commoners wore crimson dark dress.

sentences.zh: 升自西階，進立於席西，南向。

translations.literal: He ascended the west steps, advanced, and stood south-facing west of the mat.
translations.idiomatic: He mounted the west steps and stood south-facing west of the mat.

sentences.zh: 贊者酌酒進，北面以授子，子再拜受爵。

translations.literal: The announcer poured wine forward, north-facing, and handed the goblet to the son; the son bowed twice and received the goblet.
translations.idiomatic: The announcer advanced wine north-facing to the son; he bowed twice and received the goblet.

sentences.zh: 贊者薦脯醢於席前，子升席，跪，左執爵，右取脯，擩於醢，祭於籩、豆之間。

translations.literal: The announcer presented dried meat and hash before the mat; the son mounted the mat, knelt, left on the goblet, right took dried meat, dipped in hash, and sacrificed between basket and dish.
translations.idiomatic: The announcer presented dried meat and hash; the son mounted the mat, knelt, offered between basket and dish.

sentences.zh: 右祭酒，執爵興，降席西，南面跪，卒爵，再拜，執爵興。

translations.literal: He sacrificed to the wine with the right hand, took the goblet, rose, descended west of the mat, knelt south-facing, finished the goblet, bowed twice, took the goblet, and rose.
translations.idiomatic: He offered to the wine with his right hand, rose, knelt south-facing west of the mat, drained the goblet, bowed twice, and rose.

sentences.zh: 贊者受虛爵還尊所。

translations.literal: The announcer received the empty goblet and returned it to the jar.
translations.idiomatic: The announcer took the empty goblet back to the jar.

sentences.zh: 子進立於父席前，東面。

translations.literal: The son advanced and stood east-facing before his father's mat.
translations.idiomatic: The son advanced and stood east-facing before his father's mat.

sentences.zh: 父命之曰：「往迎尒相，承我宗事，勗率以敬，先妣之嗣，若則有常。

translations.literal: The father charged him: "Go welcome your partner; uphold our ancestral affair; strive and lead with reverence; your late mother's heir—if so, there is constancy."
translations.idiomatic: The father charged him: "Go welcome your consort; uphold our line; strive with reverence; as your late mother's heir, keep constant."

sentences.zh: 」庶子但云：「往迎爾相，勗率以敬。

translations.literal: For a secondary son only: "Go welcome your consort; strive and lead with reverence."
translations.idiomatic: For a secondary son only: "Go welcome your consort; strive with reverence."

sentences.zh: 」子再拜曰：「不敢忘命。

translations.literal: The son bowed twice and said: "I dare not forget the charge."
translations.idiomatic: The son bowed twice: "I dare not forget."

sentences.zh: 」又再拜，降，出，乃迎。

translations.literal: He bowed twice again, descended, went out, and then went to welcome her.
translations.idiomatic: He bowed twice again, went out, and went to welcome her.

sentences.zh: 初昏，設洗、陳饌皆如親王。

translations.literal: At first dusk, lavabo and food array were all as for an imperial prince.
translations.idiomatic: At first dusk lavabo and food followed an imperial prince.

sentences.zh: 牲用少牢及腊，三俎、二籩、二簠，其豆數：一品十六，二品十四，三品十二。

translations.literal: Victims used lesser pen and cured meat; three trays, two baskets, two grain trays; dish count: first rank sixteen, second fourteen, third twelve.
translations.idiomatic: Victims were lesser pen and cured meat; three trays, two baskets, two grain trays; dishes: rank one sixteen, two fourteen, three twelve.

sentences.zh: 壻及婦共牢，婦之簋、簠及豆、豋之數，各視其夫。

translations.literal: Groom and bride shared the pen; the bride's trays, bowls, dishes, and tureens each followed her husband's count.
translations.idiomatic: Groom and bride shared the pen; the bride's vessels matched her husband's rank count.

sentences.zh: 尊於室中北墉下，設尊於房戶外之東，加冪、勺，無玄酒。

translations.literal: Wine jar at the north wall inside the chamber; another jar east outside the door with cover and ladle, no black wine.
translations.idiomatic: Wine at the north wall inside; another east outside the door with cover and ladle, no black wine.

sentences.zh: 夫婦酌於內，尊四，爵兩，巹凡六，夫婦各三酳。

translations.literal: Husband and wife poured inside; four jars, two goblets, six nuptial gourds—husband and wife each three toasts.
translations.idiomatic: Husband and wife poured inside: four jars, two goblets, six gourds—they each made three toasts.

sentences.zh: 主人乘革輅，至於婦氏大門外。

translations.literal: The host rode a leather carriage to outside the bride's family great gate.
translations.idiomatic: The host rode a leather carriage to the bride's main gate.

sentences.zh: 女準其夫服，花釵、翟衣，入於房，以觶酌醴，如王妃。

translations.literal: The woman matched her husband's dress, flower pins and feather robe; entering the chamber she poured wine with a goblet as for an imperial prince's consort.
translations.idiomatic: The bride matched her husband's rank in dress, flower pins and feather robe; in the chamber she poured wine as for a prince's consort.

sentences.zh: 主人迎賓以入，遂同牢，皆如親王納妃之禮。

translations.literal: The host welcomed the guest in and then shared the pen, all as at an imperial prince taking a consort.
translations.idiomatic: The host welcomed the guest in and shared the pen, all as for a prince's consort.

sentences.zh: 質明，布舅席於東序，西向；

translations.literal: At daybreak, the father-in-law's mat was spread on the east wing, west-facing;
translations.idiomatic: At daybreak the father-in-law's mat was on the east wing, west-facing;

sentences.zh: 布姑席於房戶外之西，南向。

translations.literal: the mother-in-law's mat west outside the chamber door, south-facing.
translations.idiomatic: the mother-in-law's mat west outside the chamber door, south-facing.

sentences.zh: 舅姑即席，婦執笲棗、栗入，升自西階，東面再拜，進，跪奠於舅席前，舅撫之，婦退，復位，又再拜。

translations.literal: Father-in-law and mother-in-law took their mats; the bride carried a basket of dates and chestnuts, ascended the west steps, east-facing bowed twice, advanced, knelt, and set them before the father-in-law's mat; he stroked them; the bride withdrew, returned, and bowed twice again.
translations.idiomatic: In-laws took their mats; the bride brought dates and chestnuts, mounted the west steps, bowed twice east-facing, knelt before the father-in-law's mat; he touched them; she withdrew, returned, and bowed twice again.

sentences.zh: 降自西階，受笲腶脩，升，進，北面再拜，進，跪奠於姑席前，姑舉之，婦退，復位，又再拜。

translations.literal: She descended the west steps, received a basket of cured meat, ascended, advanced, north-facing bowed twice, advanced, knelt before the mother-in-law's mat; she lifted them; the bride withdrew, returned, and bowed twice again.
translations.idiomatic: She went down the west steps, took cured meat, mounted, bowed twice north-facing, knelt before the mother-in-law's mat; she raised them; the bride withdrew and bowed twice again.

sentences.zh: 婦席於姑西少北，南向。

translations.literal: The bride's mat was slightly north of the mother-in-law west, south-facing.
translations.idiomatic: The bride's mat lay slightly north of the mother-in-law, south-facing.

sentences.zh: 側尊甒醴於房內東壁下，籩、豆一，實以脯醢，在尊北。

translations.literal: Side jar of black-cloth wine under the east wall inside the chamber; one basket and one dish of dried meat and hash north of the jar.
translations.idiomatic: A side jar of black-cloth wine under the east wall inside; one basket and dish of dried meat and hash north of it.

sentences.zh: 設洗於東房近北。

translations.literal: A lavabo was set near the north of the east chamber.
translations.idiomatic: A lavabo was set near the north of the east chamber.

sentences.zh: 婦立於席西，南面。

translations.literal: The bride stood west of the mat, south-facing.
translations.idiomatic: The bride stood west of the mat, south-facing.

sentences.zh: 內贊者盥手，洗觶，酌醴，加柶，面柄，北面立于婦前。

translations.literal: The inner announcer washed hands, rinsed the goblet, poured wine, added the ladle handle-out, and stood north-facing before the bride.
translations.idiomatic: The inner announcer washed, rinsed the goblet, poured wine, set the ladle handle-out, and stood north-facing before the bride.

sentences.zh: 婦進，東面拜受，復位。

translations.literal: The bride advanced, east-facing bowed and received, and returned to her place.
translations.idiomatic: The bride advanced, bowed east-facing, received it, and returned.

sentences.zh: 內贊者西階上，北面拜送，乃薦脯醢。

translations.literal: The inner announcer on the west steps north-facing bowed in send-off, then presented dried meat and hash.
translations.idiomatic: The inner announcer on the west steps bowed north-facing in send-off, then presented dried meat and hash.

sentences.zh: 婦升席，坐，左執觶，右取脯，擩於醢，祭於籩、豆之間，以柶祭醴三，始扱一祭，又扱再祭，加柶於觶，面葉，興，降席西，東面坐，啐醴，建柶，興，拜。

translations.literal: The bride mounted the mat and sat, left on the goblet, right took dried meat, dipped in hash, sacrificed between basket and dish, with the ladle sacrificed to the wine three times—first dip once, dip again twice—placed the ladle on the goblet handle-out, rose, descended west of the mat, sat east-facing, tasted wine, set the ladle upright, rose, and bowed.
translations.idiomatic: The bride sat on the mat, offered between basket and dish, ladle-offered to the wine three times, set the ladle handle-out, tasted wine west of the mat, set the ladle upright, rose, and bowed.

sentences.zh: 內贊者答拜。

translations.literal: The inner announcer returned the bow.
translations.idiomatic: The inner announcer returned the bow.

sentences.zh: 婦進升席，跪，奠觶於豆東，取脯，降自西階以出，授婦氏從人於寢門外。

translations.literal: The bride advanced, mounted the mat, knelt, set the goblet east of the dish, took dried meat, descended the west steps, went out, and handed it to the bride's family follower outside the apartment gate.
translations.idiomatic: The bride advanced, knelt on the mat, set the goblet east of the dish, took dried meat, went down the west steps out, and gave it to a bride's follower outside the apartment gate.

sentences.zh: 盥饋。

translations.literal: Hand-washing and feeding.
translations.idiomatic: Hand-washing and feeding.

sentences.zh: 舅、姑入於室，婦盥饋。

translations.literal: Father-in-law and mother-in-law entered the chamber; the bride washed hands and fed them.
translations.idiomatic: The in-laws entered the chamber; the bride washed her hands and served them.

sentences.zh: 布席於室之奧，舅、姑共席坐，俱東面南上。

translations.literal: Mats were spread in the recess of the chamber; father-in-law and mother-in-law shared a mat, both east-facing with south at the top.
translations.idiomatic: Mats in the chamber recess; in-laws shared one mat, both east-facing, south at top.

sentences.zh: 贊者設尊於室內北墉下，饌於房內西墉下，如同牢。

translations.literal: The announcer set a wine jar under the north wall inside the chamber and food under the west wall inside, as at the shared meal.
translations.idiomatic: The announcer set wine under the north wall inside and food under the west wall, as at the shared meal.

sentences.zh: 牲體皆節折，右載之於舅俎，左載之於姑俎。

translations.literal: All meat was sectioned; right portions loaded on the father-in-law's tray, left on the mother-in-law's tray.
translations.idiomatic: All meat was sectioned; right portions on the father-in-law's tray, left on the mother-in-law's.

sentences.zh: 婦入，升自西階，入房，以醬進。

translations.literal: The bride entered, ascended the west steps, entered the chamber, and advanced with sauce.
translations.idiomatic: The bride mounted the west steps, entered, and advanced with sauce.

sentences.zh: 其他饌，從者設之，皆加匕箸。

translations.literal: Other food followers set out, all with spoons and chopsticks added.
translations.idiomatic: Followers set out the rest, each with spoons and chopsticks.

sentences.zh: 俎入，設於豆東。

translations.literal: Trays entered and were set east of the dishes.
translations.idiomatic: Trays were brought in east of the dishes.

sentences.zh: 贊者各授箸，舅、姑各以篚葅擩於醬，祭於籩、豆之間，又祭飯訖，乃食，三飯，卒食。

translations.literal: Announcers each handed chopsticks; father-in-law and mother-in-law each with a basket of pickles dipped in sauce, sacrificed between basket and dish, then sacrificed to the rice; then they ate, three mouthfuls, finished eating.
translations.idiomatic: Announcers handed chopsticks; each in-law dipped pickles in sauce, offered between dishes and to the rice, then ate three mouthfuls and finished.

sentences.zh: 婦入於房，盥手洗爵，入室，酌酒酳舅，進奠爵舅席前少東，西面再拜，舅取爵祭酒，飲之。

translations.literal: The bride entered the chamber, washed hands, rinsed the goblet, entered, poured wine to toast the father-in-law, advanced, set the goblet slightly east before his mat, west-facing bowed twice; the father-in-law took the goblet, sacrificed to the wine, and drank.
translations.idiomatic: The bride washed, rinsed a goblet, entered, poured a toast for the father-in-law, set it slightly east of his mat, bowed twice west-facing; he took it, offered to the wine, and drank.

sentences.zh: 婦受爵出戶，入房，奠於右。

translations.literal: The bride received the goblet out the door, entered the chamber, and set it on the right.
translations.idiomatic: She took the goblet out, re-entered, and set it on the right.

sentences.zh: 盥手洗爵，酌酒酳姑。

translations.literal: She washed hands, rinsed the goblet, and poured wine to toast the mother-in-law.
translations.idiomatic: She washed again, rinsed the goblet, and poured a toast for the mother-in-law.

sentences.zh: 設婦席於室內北墉下，尊東面，婦徹饌，設於席前如初，西上。

translations.literal: The bride's mat was set under the north wall inside the chamber, east of the jar; the bride cleared the food and set it before the mat as at first, west at the top.
translations.idiomatic: Her mat was under the north wall inside, east of the jar; she cleared food and reset it before the mat, west at top.

sentences.zh: 婦進，西面再拜，退，升席，南向坐。

translations.literal: The bride advanced, west-facing bowed twice, withdrew, mounted the mat, and sat south-facing.
translations.idiomatic: The bride advanced, bowed twice west-facing, withdrew, mounted the mat, and sat south-facing.

sentences.zh: 將餕，舅命易醬，內贊者易之。

translations.literal: About to be fed, the father-in-law ordered the sauce changed; the inner announcer changed it.
translations.idiomatic: Before she was fed, the father-in-law ordered the sauce changed; the inner announcer changed it.

sentences.zh: 婦及餕姑饌，婦祭，內贊者助之。

translations.literal: The bride was fed the mother-in-law's food; the bride sacrificed; the inner announcer assisted.
translations.idiomatic: The bride was served the mother-in-law's food; she offered; the inner announcer assisted.

sentences.zh: 既祭，乃食，三飯，卒食。

translations.literal: After sacrificing they ate, three mouthfuls, finished eating.
translations.idiomatic: After offering she ate three mouthfuls and finished.

sentences.zh: 內贊者洗爵酌酒酳婦，降席，西面再拜，受爵，升席坐，祭酒，飲，執爵興，降席東，南面立。

translations.literal: The inner announcer washed the goblet, poured wine to toast the bride; she descended the mat, west-facing bowed twice, received the goblet, mounted and sat, sacrificed to the wine, drank, took the goblet, rose, descended east of the mat, and stood south-facing.
translations.idiomatic: The inner announcer washed the goblet and toasted the bride; she left the mat, bowed twice west-facing, received it, sat, offered to the wine, drank, rose with the goblet, descended east of the mat, and stood south-facing.

sentences.zh: 內贊者受爵，奠於坫。

translations.literal: The inner announcer received the goblet and set it on the stand.
translations.idiomatic: The inner announcer took the goblet and set it on the stand.

sentences.zh: 婦進，西面再拜，受爵，升席坐，祭酒，飲訖，執爵興，降席東，南面立。

translations.literal: The bride advanced, west-facing bowed twice, received the goblet, mounted and sat, sacrificed to the wine, finished drinking, took the goblet, rose, descended east of the mat, and stood south-facing.
translations.idiomatic: The bride advanced, bowed twice west-facing, received the goblet, sat, offered to the wine, drank it off, rose, descended east of the mat, and stood south-facing.

sentences.zh: 內贊者受奠於篚，婦進，西面再拜。

translations.literal: The inner announcer received and set it in the basket; the bride advanced and west-facing bowed twice.
translations.idiomatic: The inner announcer set it in the basket; the bride advanced and bowed twice west-facing.

sentences.zh: 舅、姑先降自西階，婦降自阼階。

translations.literal: Father-in-law and mother-in-law first descended the west steps; the bride descended the host steps.
translations.idiomatic: The in-laws went down the west steps first; the bride descended the host steps.

sentences.zh: 凡庶子婦，舅不降，而婦降自西階以出。

translations.literal: For wives of secondary sons, the father-in-law did not descend, and the wife descended the west steps to go out.
translations.idiomatic: For secondary sons' wives, the father-in-law did not descend; the wife left by the west steps.
